scope.note: Value left the hot wallets of NoOnes, a custodial P2P marketplace, on Ethereum, Tron, Solana and BSC. The CEO attributed the failure to 'our Solana bridge', a platform component that no source describes further. No source describes a bridge escrow or an unbacked bridge mint; the event resembles an exchange hot-wallet drain. DefiLlama's 'Cross-Chain Message Spoofing' label is not supported by any source read.
